metadata.loading: Prescribed plate reference; cable lengths held slack; plate reactions are external
metadata.reference: Provisional stress-free parabola; no measured assembly preload
metadata.limits: Two-DOF guided plate; massless straight tension-only cable spans; no motor mapping, sag, friction, steel contact, gravity or inertia
metadata.contact: Frictionless penalty between simplified solid plate envelopes; not exact CAD collision
metadata.solver: Block Newton / two-coordinate Schur complement, energy line search, adaptive load subdivision; upstream Hessian used as Newton approximation
